# Starter checklist content: review sheet

<!-- Generated by `pnpm run checklists:sheet` from src/features/checklists/starter-templates.json and the locale files. Do not edit by hand. -->

Content version 2. **Status: draft, not reviewed.** Claude drafted every item (D-27, K-04, FR3-CHK-8). Before the Phase 3 beta, the product owner reviews every item, and a qualified health reviewer in each market checks the items flagged **health** in that market's locale. Items flagged **legal** touch legal or government admin and get the product owner's check against official sources. Sign-off for each locale is kept with the release notes, not here.

Rules every item follows: it names a practical action, never medical advice or a clinical timing. Health items never get a suggested date, and say to book or check with the family's provider. "—" means the item isn't offered in that market.

Due dates are suggestions, counted from the first day of the due month for expecting checklists and from the day a newborn checklist starts.

## Health review by market

Each market's health reviewer checks these items in their own locale.

### US (en-US)

- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_pregnancy_records`: Pack photo ID, your insurance card and any paperwork your hospital asked for
- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_birth_preferences`: Pack a copy of your birth preferences, if you've written them
- `checklist_item.expecting.choose_baby_doctor`: Choose a pediatrician or family doctor for the baby
- `checklist_item.expecting.preregister_birth_place`: Fill in your hospital or birth center's admission forms
- `checklist_item.newborn.book_first_checkup`: Book the baby's first check-up with the pediatrician, as your provider advises
- `checklist_item.newborn.book_parent_checkup`: Book the birthing parent's postpartum check-up, as your provider advises
- `checklist_item.newborn.save_health_contacts`: Save your pediatrician's office and after-hours numbers in both phones

### GB (en-GB)

- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_pregnancy_records`: Pack your maternity notes, or check you can open them on your phone
- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_birth_preferences`: Pack a copy of your birth preferences, if you've written them
- `checklist_item.expecting.get_maternity_certificate`: Ask your midwife or GP for the maternity certificate your employer needs
- `checklist_item.expecting.apply_maternity_exemption`: Apply for a maternity exemption certificate for free NHS dental care
- `checklist_item.newborn.register_with_gp`: Register the baby with your GP surgery
- `checklist_item.newborn.book_first_checkup`: Book the baby's check-up with your GP surgery, as they advise
- `checklist_item.newborn.keep_health_record_handy`: Keep the baby's red book somewhere easy to find
- `checklist_item.newborn.book_parent_checkup`: Book the birthing parent's postnatal check with the GP, as they advise
- `checklist_item.newborn.save_health_contacts`: Save your GP surgery's number and the NHS non-emergency number in both phones

### AU (en-AU)

- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_pregnancy_records`: Pack your Medicare card and your pregnancy health record
- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_birth_preferences`: Pack a copy of your birth preferences, if you've written them
- `checklist_item.expecting.choose_baby_doctor`: Choose a GP for the baby's check-ups
- `checklist_item.expecting.preregister_birth_place`: Fill in your hospital or birth centre's admission forms
- `checklist_item.newborn.enrol_in_medicare`: Enrol the baby in Medicare
- `checklist_item.newborn.book_first_checkup`: Book the baby's first check with your child and family health nurse or GP
- `checklist_item.newborn.keep_health_record_handy`: Keep the baby's health record book somewhere easy to find
- `checklist_item.newborn.book_parent_checkup`: Book the birthing parent's postnatal check-up, as your provider advises
- `checklist_item.newborn.save_health_contacts`: Save your GP and the Pregnancy, Birth and Baby helpline numbers in both phones

## Legal review by market

The product owner checks these items against official sources for each market.

### US (en-US)

- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_pregnancy_records`: Pack photo ID, your insurance card and any paperwork your hospital asked for
- `checklist_item.expecting.plan_parental_leave`: Tell your employers your leave plans, and check what leave and pay you can get
- `checklist_item.expecting.check_leave_pay`: Check whether your state offers paid family leave, and how to apply
- `checklist_item.expecting.check_insurance_for_baby`: Find out how to add the baby to your insurance plan, and the enrollment deadline
- `checklist_item.expecting.update_wills`: Make or update your wills, and choose a guardian for the baby
- `checklist_item.expecting.review_life_insurance`: Review your life insurance
- `checklist_item.newborn.register_birth`: Check the birth certificate application has been filed, and order certified copies
- `checklist_item.newborn.check_ssn_card`: Check the baby's Social Security card arrives, and store it safely
- `checklist_item.newborn.add_baby_to_insurance`: Add the baby to your insurance plan before the enrollment deadline
- `checklist_item.newborn.update_employers`: Tell your employers the baby has arrived, and confirm your leave dates
- `checklist_item.newborn.apply_for_passport`: Apply for the baby's passport, if you plan to travel

### GB (en-GB)

- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_pregnancy_records`: Pack your maternity notes, or check you can open them on your phone
- `checklist_item.expecting.plan_parental_leave`: Tell your employers your plans for maternity leave, paternity leave or shared parental leave
- `checklist_item.expecting.check_leave_pay`: Check whether you can get Statutory Maternity Pay, Maternity Allowance or Paternity Pay
- `checklist_item.expecting.get_maternity_certificate`: Ask your midwife or GP for the maternity certificate your employer needs
- `checklist_item.expecting.apply_maternity_exemption`: Apply for a maternity exemption certificate for free NHS dental care
- `checklist_item.expecting.update_wills`: Make or update your wills, and choose a guardian for the baby
- `checklist_item.expecting.review_life_insurance`: Review your life insurance
- `checklist_item.newborn.register_birth`: Book an appointment to register the birth at your local register office
- `checklist_item.newborn.claim_family_payments`: Claim Child Benefit
- `checklist_item.newborn.update_employers`: Tell your employers the baby has arrived, and confirm your leave dates
- `checklist_item.newborn.apply_for_passport`: Apply for the baby's passport, if you plan to travel

### AU (en-AU)

- `checklist_item.expecting.pack_pregnancy_records`: Pack your Medicare card and your pregnancy health record
- `checklist_item.expecting.plan_parental_leave`: Tell your employers your parental leave plans, and check what leave you can take
- `checklist_item.expecting.check_leave_pay`: Check whether you can get Parental Leave Pay from Services Australia, and apply
- `checklist_item.expecting.check_insurance_for_baby`: Find out how to add the baby to your private insurance policy, if you have one
- `checklist_item.expecting.update_wills`: Make or update your wills, and choose a guardian for the baby
- `checklist_item.expecting.review_life_insurance`: Review your life insurance
- `checklist_item.newborn.register_birth`: Register the birth with your state or territory's registry
- `checklist_item.newborn.claim_family_payments`: Claim Family Tax Benefit through myGov
- `checklist_item.newborn.enrol_in_medicare`: Enrol the baby in Medicare
- `checklist_item.newborn.add_baby_to_insurance`: Add the baby to your private insurance policy, if you have one
- `checklist_item.newborn.update_employers`: Tell your employers the baby has arrived, and confirm your leave dates
- `checklist_item.newborn.apply_for_passport`: Apply for the baby's passport, if you plan to travel
